game.name: ProjectDural (Virtua Fighter 2)
game.desc: Native ARM64 / OpenGL ES 2.0 static recompilation runtime for Sega Model 2A Virtua Fighter 2 (Version 2.1), tuned for Allwinner H700 / Anbernic RG34XX with on-device SLJIT ARM64 compilation, 3:2 widescreen, and Core 2 SCSP sound. Bring your own MAME vf2.zip.
game.developer: SEGA AM2 (Recomp: mr-finster, ARM64 Port: ProjectDural)
